title: Equatorial Moon
description: Rotates the moon texture so that it lies horizontally, as if viewed from the equator!
body:
Equatorial Moon is a simple, lightweight resource pack that rotates all vanilla moon textures so that they lie horizontally and appear as if it is being viewed from the equator.

Notes:
- Does not alter New Moon texture
- Compatible with most shader packs that do not alter the vanilla moon texture (e.g. BSL, Complementary Reimagined)
